typedown.editor.fontFamily.markdownDescription: Font family for the markdown editor. If not set, uses VS Code's `editor.fontFamily` setting.

typedown.editor.fontSize.markdownDescription: Font size for the markdown editor. If not set, uses VS Code's `editor.fontSize` setting.

typedown.codeBlock.tokenColors.description: Override colors for code block syntax highlighting. By default, colors are extracted from your current VS Code theme. Use this to override specific token colors.
typedown.codeBlock.tokenColors.markdownDescription:
Override colors for code block syntax highlighting. By default, colors are **automatically extracted from your current VS Code theme**. Use this setting to override specific token colors if needed.

Example:
```json
{
  "comment": "#6a9955",
  "keyword": "#569cd6",
  "string": "#ce9178"
}
```

Available token types: `comment`, `keyword`, `string`, `number`, `function`, `variable`, `operator`, `punctuation`, `property`, `tag`

keyword.description: Color for keywords (if, else, return, etc.)
